title: SigVectorLite pocket vector DB
description: Signature Vector Lite is a Signature original: an embeddable file-based vector database with a two-line Python API, collections with schemas, HNSW/IVF indexes, and filtered search — designed for local projects that outgrow in-memory lists. Its file format, API, and graduation path are original Signature designs.

demo.program:
print('SigLite("./sigvec.db")  # two lines to a vector DB')
print('edition: Signature original')
demo.expected_output:
SigLite("./sigvec.db")  # two lines to a vector DB
edition: Signature original

title: SigLite zero-install start
description: SigLite is one pip package with no services; opening a path creates the database file automatically. The auto-create-on-open behavior is Signature-original.

demo.program: print('db = SigLite("./app.sigdb")  # file created on open')
demo.expected_output: db = SigLite("./app.sigdb")  # file created on open
